title: YouTube Automation with AI
description: An in‑depth exploration of how artificial intelligence can streamline the creation, optimisation and monetisation of YouTube channels. The video covers content ideation, script generation, video editing, thumbnail design, SEO, audience analytics and ethical considerations.
